notes.title: 1.2.0 Update is out!
notes.notes:
1.2.0 Update is out! This update will bring Quality of Life improvements and will add the gallery at the end of the game, so you could view all photo cards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40036758/7c8948cb2f68c296cdab4a181e241f87745dcfe0.png[/img]

Change list:
[list]
[*]Added gallery
[*]Updated localization
[*]Performance enhancements
[*]UI/UX improvements
[*]Minor fixes
[/list]
